[Getz Pharma](https://getzpharma.com/) manufactures a wide variety of branded generic pharmaceutical products covering key therapeutic segments like cardiology, diabetology, gastroenterology, and infectious diseases. Well-known product lines include anti-diabetics (such as _Diampa_ and _Getryl_), cardiovascular medications (_Amtas_, _Cova_), and various antibiotics and respiratory treatments available internationally and locally through platforms like [Watsons Philippines](https://www.watsons.com.ph/c/shop-getz-pharma).

- **Cardiology & Blood Pressure:** Amtas, Cova, Cova-H

- **Diabetology & Metabolism:** Diampa (Empagliflozin), Dafo (Dapagliflozin), Getryl

- **Infectious Diseases & Antibiotics:** Cipesta (Ciprofloxacin), Getmoxy, Zetro

- **Gastroenterology:** Risek, Nexum, Ribazole

- **Respiratory & Pulmonology:** Saltra, Fortide, Respomatic [](https://getzpharma.com/products/)

Overview of Health Monitoring Technologies
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Small wearable sensors placed under the skin to track interstitial fluid glucose levels in real time for diabetes management.

Smartwatches:
Wrist-worn devices featuring optical sensors (PPG) to track heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO2), and activity.
Amazon.in
Wearable ECG:
Specialized sensors or watch-embedded electrodes designed to record the electrical activity of the heart and detect arrhythmias like atrial fibrillation.
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers:
Devices or under-mattress pads that evaluate sleep stages, movement, and resting heart rate.
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Systems that use connected medical devices to passively collect and transmit vital signs to clinical care teams.
